answer: Beacon-Bound Acoustic Handshake. Each agent identity must embed a hardware beacon emitting a factory-set ultrasound chirp tied to one physical die. Registries verify live chirp timing under a random gale of clock offsets, and identity sonnet phrases are signed with that die's key. One operator can own many dies but cannot clone a die's chirp, so each extra identity costs a distinct physical chip plus its attestation.
